info.name: WSO2 API Manager - Admin Advanced Policy (Collection) Advanced Policy (Collection) Webhooks API
Get available web hook subscriptions for a given application.

params.name: applicationId
params.description: **Application Identifier** consisting of the UUID of the Application.

params.name: apiId
params.description: **API ID** consisting of the **UUID** of the API.

items.docs:
This operation will provide a list of web hook topic subscriptions for a given application. If the api id is provided
results will be filtered by the api Id.
